sections.advice: Srinagar → Sonamarg is 65 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Sonamarg → Zoji La climbs about 3528 m in 21 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Zoji La → Dras drops about 3528 m over 37 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Dras → Kargil is 47 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Kargil → Lamayuru is 82 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Lamayuru → Fotu La climbs about 4108 m in 9 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Fotu La → Leh drops about 4108 m over 86 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3528 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 3528 m come off over 67 km at around 9.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

scenicChapters.title: Fotu La → Leh
scenicChapters.narrative: 154 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

srinagar-leh-highway.story: From Srinagar it runs 623 km to Leh; allow about 8 h 28 of riding. It goes by way of Sonamarg, Zoji La, Dras and Kargil. The highest point is about 4,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
